{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes, especially when sentiment is neutral or negative.",
    "Adjust forecasts downward if recent history shows persistent downward drift and sentiment is negative.",
    "Increase downward bias in forecasts when sentiment turns negative and price has recently been above 70.00.",
    "Apply mean reversion correction if forecast deviates >15% from 30-day moving average of true outcomes.",
    "Lower forecast for periods with negative sentiment and low recent volatility (e.g., <5% range over last 5 days).",
    "Avoid overreacting to single-day sentiment shifts; lag corrections by 2–3 days for sentiment-driven moves.",
    "If true outcome is consistently below forecast for 3 consecutive days, reduce forecast by 2–5% per day until convergence.",
    "When sentiment is negative and price is above 75.00, apply downward pressure correction of 3–7% to prevent overvaluation."
  ]
}
